title: W16-A: pure workflow_control decision module (grant+confirmed-ownership preconditions, observer-only and guessed-action refusal, requested/acknowledged/result receipt); Pi tool registration excluded
description:
Every `workflow_*` Pi tool and every `workbench:*` grant check lives in src/index.ts (hot, Sr. Engineer-owned), and native Furnace control would live in src/workbench/providers/furnace.ts (hot). W16's acceptance "compact bounded result and ACL" still needs a testable control core. Deliver it as ONE new source file and ONE new test file; register nothing.

src/workbench/control.ts (new), pure and provider-free:
- `interface NativeControlRequest { scope: ObservationScope; principal: { id: string; role?: string }; grants: readonly string[] | undefined; target: NativeRef; action: string; params?: JsonValue; invocationId: string; requestedAt: string }` (names follow docs/workbench/13 Host boundary `requestControl(req: NativeControlRequest): Promise<NativeControlReceipt>`; this bead implements the decision, not the host method).
- `decideControl(request, deps: { projection: ObservationProjection; now: () => string })` returns `{ decision: 'denied'; category: CapabilityErrorCategory; reason: string }` or `{ decision: 'permitted'; receipt: NativeControlReceipt }`.
- `NativeControlReceipt` phases are distinct and ordered: `requested` -> `acknowledged` -> `result`. Fields: contractVersion 'workbench.control/v1', requestId, principal, grant, policy (rule name), target, action, invocationId, ownershipConfirmationRef, requestedAt; `acknowledge(receipt, { acknowledgedAt, nativeAckRef })` and `settle(receipt, { outcome: 'completed'|'failed'|'cancelled'|'unknown'; nativeResultRef: string; settledAt })` return new frozen receipts and throw CapabilityError('validation') on out-of-order transitions or missing native references. The module never calls a provider, never mutates the projection, never fabricates acknowledged/result.
- Deny rules (first match wins, every rule has a test): grants undefined/non-array/non-string entries or any wildcard (`control:*`) -> authorization "unknown permission data"; grants containing only discover:/inspect:/observe: prefixes -> authorization "observer-only" regardless of action spelling (stop, STOP, terminate, __proto__); action not in the frozen per-provider allowlist (furnace: stop; claude-agent-sdk: interrupt; forge: cancel) -> validation "unknown action"; missing exact grant `control:<provider>.<action>` -> authorization; target key not in the request scope (different workspace/principal) -> authorization "cross-scope"; target lacking a projection `ownership` relation whose provenance.source === target.provider AND provenance.nativeConfirmationRef is a non-empty string (re-check both; do not trust the relation kind alone) -> authorization "no confirmed lifecycle ownership" (causation/grouping/hypothesis edges never qualify); destructive actions (stop, cancel, interrupt, kill, delete) without `params.confirmed === true` -> validation "operator confirmation required".
test/workbench-control.test.ts (new): one test per rule plus the phase-ordering falsifiers; no TTY, no providers, no network.
Out of scope: any edit to src/index.ts, src/workbench/providers/furnace.ts, src/workbench/claude-host.ts or other hot files; Pi tool registration; executing a native stop. If the worker finds registration necessary to satisfy acceptance, stop and return blocked.
acceptance_criteria:
All criteria quote docs/workbench specs in the rig (branch workbench/implementation-program).
1. docs/workbench/11-designer-and-operator.md § "First public Pi tools (proposed)": "workflow_control(ref,action,params?): explicit native action after permission/preconditions; returns requested/acknowledged/result distinct." -> three distinct phase literals; `settle` on a `requested` receipt throws; `acknowledge` twice throws; a receipt can never carry phase `result` without a non-empty nativeResultRef.
2. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md § "State/event semantics": "Cancellation request != accepted cancellation != terminal cancellation." -> JSON.stringify of a `requested` receipt contains neither "acknowledged" nor "completed"; the three receipts differ in phase and carry their own timestamps.
3. docs/workbench/08-lifecycle-and-recovery.md § "Cancellation and ownership": "Multi-reader shared child MUST NOT be stopped merely because one reader closed Pi or stopped waiting. Child cancellation depends on explicit native owner rights and native API semantics." -> a target with only causation/grouping/hypothesis relations is denied; an `ownership` relation with provenance.source === target.provider and a non-empty nativeConfirmationRef permits; the receipt copies that nativeConfirmationRef as ownershipConfirmationRef.
4. docs/workbench/11-designer-and-operator.md § "Acceptance journeys": "An observer-only Pi instance cannot stop the Run, even with a guessed action name." and docs/workbench/12-security.md § "Security acceptance tests": "observer-only stop refused; cross-workspace ref returns authorization failure" -> grants ['observe:furnace.run.inspect'] with actions stop/STOP/terminate/__proto__ are all denied with category 'authorization'; a target in another workspace or principal is denied 'authorization' even with a valid control grant.
5. docs/workbench/12-security.md § "Authorization design": "Control decisions require native ownership/preconditions and, for destructive actions, operator confirmation." and "Treat unknown permission data as deny." -> stop without params.confirmed === true is denied 'validation'; grants undefined, [42], ['control:*'] are denied 'authorization'.
6. docs/workbench/12-security.md § "Auditability": "Record authorized principal, capability contract version, logical invocation, target native ref, reason/policy, request acknowledgment and producer outcome for control operations." -> the permitted receipt has principal, contractVersion, invocationId, target, policy, and after transitions nativeAckRef and outcome/nativeResultRef; Object.isFrozen(receipt) is true at every phase.
7. docs/workbench/02-atomic-requirements.md WB-040: "Control actions have native preconditions, permission checks, prompts/confirmations and acknowledgements." and WB-030: "Layout, reducers, status classification and control capabilities are pure/testable without a real terminal." -> the whole suite runs with no TTY, no provider, no network; decideControl is synchronous and side-effect free (projection spy shows only read calls: relations/indexOf/window).
8. docs/workbench/06-capability-registry.md § "Current experimental policy surface": "No universal observe/control methods are manufactured for producers." -> the allowlist is frozen per provider and an unlisted provider (e.g. hyperunix) has no permitted action at all.

title: W15-A: lazy bounded native evidence loader contract for inspector details (loaded on focus; unavailable is visible, never fabricated); dialog/host wiring excluded
description:
Today src/ui/workflow-inspector.ts details view prints "Evidence / details · producer references, not fetched payload" and lists raw evidenceRefs strings; nothing can be loaded. Add the lazy, bounded native evidence loader CONTRACT and its inspector integration without touching any hot file. Real provider loaders (Forge gate status, Furnace run, Claude transcript) and dialog/host wiring are the parent W15/Sr. Engineer's work.

Deliver:
1. src/workbench/evidence-loader.ts (new):
   - `interface EvidenceLoader { readonly provider: string; canLoad(ref: string): boolean; load(ref: string, context: { scope: ObservationScope; signal: AbortSignal; maxBytes: number }): Promise<EvidenceContent> }`.
   - `type EvidenceEntry = {state:'not-requested'} | {state:'loading'} | {state:'loaded'; provider: string; capturedAt: string; bytes: number; truncated: boolean; preview: readonly string[]} | {state:'unavailable'; reason:'no-loader'|'unauthorized'|'transport'|'timeout'|'too-large'}`.
   - `class EvidenceStore` constructed with `{ loaders: readonly EvidenceLoader[]; maxEntries: number; maxBytes: number; timeoutMs: number }`: `get(scope, ref): EvidenceEntry`, `request(scope, ref): Promise<void>` (idempotent while loading), `abort(scope, ref)`, LRU eviction keyed by JSON.stringify([workspace, principal, ref]); previews are produced by passing loader text through `redactWorkbenchText` (import from src/workbench/redaction.ts — do not edit) then `safeWorkflowTerminalText` (import from src/ui/workflow-card.ts — do not edit), split into bounded lines; raw payloads are never retained. A ref whose scope does not match the store entry's scope is `unavailable: unauthorized` without consulting any loader.
2. src/ui/workflow-inspector.ts: `InspectorModel.evidence?: Pick<EvidenceStore,'get'>` (optional read side); `InspectorState.evidenceIndex: number`; in the details view `e` advances the evidence selection (wrapping) and `enter` returns `{ state, action: 'load-evidence' }` for the selected ref (new InspectorAction member — src/ui/workflow-dialog.ts' existing else-if chain ignores it, so the dialog is NOT edited in this bead); layoutInspector renders per-ref state as `not loaded (Enter)`, `loading…`, `unavailable: <reason>`, or the bounded preview lines, and never renders preview text for a ref whose entry is not `loaded`. When `model.evidence` is absent, today's rendering is unchanged (all existing inspector tests stay green).
3. Tests: test/workbench-evidence-loader.test.ts (new) and appended cases in test/workbench-inspector.test.ts (keep every existing case verbatim).

title: VC-4/W13: Furnace observer projects Attempt nodes, Run->Attempt ownership edges and source intervals (additive)
description:

Scope (atomic, additive, hot-file free): add FurnaceObserver.projectionTopology(reading) returning the unchanged Run snapshot plus one NativeSnapshot per returned Attempt (type 'attempt', bounded intervals from native started_at/finished_at only) and one 'ownership' relation Run->Attempt whose provenance.source is 'furnace' and whose nativeConfirmationRef is the attempts page requestId (the producer's own page asserts attempt.run_id === run.run_id). Partial pages produce no edges for the missing tail; stale readings throw like projectionSnapshot. projectionSnapshot() stays byte-for-byte compatible because src/index.ts:2560 (hot) consumes it; wiring projectionTopology into the Pi observe tool is a separate Sr. Engineer follow-up and is NOT part of this bead.

New additive method FurnaceObserver.projectionTopology(reading: FurnaceReading): { snapshots: NativeSnapshot[]; relations: FurnaceObservedRelation[] } where FurnaceObservedRelation is exactly the parameter type of ObservationProjection.relate. snapshots[0] deep-equals projectionSnapshot(reading); then one NativeSnapshot per reading.attempts.items entry with source {provider:'furnace', type:'attempt', id:item.id, scope:reading.source.workspaceRoot}, kind 'furnace.attempt.snapshot', node.type 'sdk-operation', statusText item.state (and outcome when present), trace {invocationId: <same as run>, correlationIds:{runId,workId}}, interval ONLY when item.startedAt exists and endedAt ONLY when item.finishedAt exists.
